newsitem.title: INDIA: Castorseed futures dip, groundnut oil looks up.
newsitem.headline: Castorseed futures dip, groundnut oil looks up.

text.p: Castorseed December delivery lost early gains to close at 1,092/1,093 rupees per quintal on Wednesday, traders said.
Reports of rising new crop despatches from the producing centres triggered bear selling at the improved level,they said.
"A tug of war is on between bear and bull operators in the trading ring," said a broker. He said the sentiment was subdued at the close amid limited export enquiries.
Groundnut oil looked up to 349/350 rupees per 10 kg from 347 rupees on fresh physical buying ahead of the wedding season.
In Rajkot, spot oil was steady at 530/535 rupees per 15 kg.
